checkpoint_source.latest_checkpoint_title: Bulk readiness review — root cause of 625/625 REVIEW identified

WORDING_MISSING.definition: Frozen semantic scope exists, but no independently acceptable wording candidate exists; all rows also lack a supported search candidate.

subanalysis.why_existing_terms_do_not_auto_approve: Some have multiple choices, broad/slang forms, ambiguity, or semantic narrowing such as green_jacket→緑ブレザー, sword→グレートソード, and grey_hair→銀髪ロング.

SEMANTIC_SCOPE_MISSING.definition: No frozen semantic scope exists and the canonical did not meet the conservative transparent-composition structural probe used for this analysis.
SEMANTIC_SCOPE_MISSING.additional_exact_reference_note: The local Special2788 reference contains 45 exact canonical rows among the current semantic-gap set, but they are currently classified LOW and many are adult/action/relation-sensitive. They are quarantine evidence candidates only, not automatic READY candidates.

HIGH_CRITICAL_EXACT_EVIDENCE_MISSING.definition: CRITICAL rows without an exact-canonical authoritative semantic scope record; R3 must remain fail-closed.

TRANSPARENT_COMPOSITION_NOT_SUPPORTED.definition: A conservative broader token-shape probe sees a possible single entity or attribute+entity composition, but the current frozen acquisition vocabulary does not authorize it.
TRANSPARENT_COMPOSITION_NOT_SUPPORTED.safety_note: These are investigation candidates, not approvals. State-like open_* forms and sky/background forms need explicit scope review; blue_sky is the only one with a single existing overlay wording candidate that looks immediately promising.

BRIDGE_RELATED.definition: No REVIEW row was caused by #32 bridge availability or contradiction. All 604 rows had bridge32_state=READY and bridge32_availability=NOT_REQUIRED.

OTHER.definition: No residual primary category remained after the deterministic classification.

safe_to_automate_in_quarantine_only: Deterministic evidence-gap classification and source/provenance reporting.
Exact-canonical reference acquisition as frozen SEMANTIC_SCOPE candidates when identity is exact and alias rows are excluded; this still requires risk and wording review.
Transparent-composition acquisition for newly specified LOW/MEDIUM token classes only after a focused false-READY test and separate wording validation.
Wording candidate extraction as candidate-only evidence; it must not become semantic authority or direct production data.
retain_for_human_or_separate_authoritati: All 9 CRITICAL rows lacking exact-canonical authoritative scope.
The 484 general semantic-scope gaps, including the 45 exact-reference candidates until adult/action/relation risk is independently resolved.
All 103 semantic-scoped rows until wording specificity, naturalness, and search/display separation are independently verified.
All 8 broader transparent-shape candidates until the new composition rule and wording are independently audited.
Any ambiguous, multi-term, slang, subtype/narrowing, or actor/target/relation-sensitive case.

additional_evidence_ready_estimate.calculation_note: The lower bound is blue_sky if its scope and wording pass an independent focused audit. The upper bound is the 103 already scoped rows plus that one transparent candidate; it assumes separate acceptable wording evidence is acquired for every scoped row. It is an upper bound, not an approval prediction.
additional_evidence_ready_estimate.excluded_from_ready_estimate: 45 exact local reference rows are counted as scope-acquisition candidates only; their current effective risk labels understate adult/action/relation sensitivity in several cases, so they remain REVIEW until separately audited.
